title: InsufficiencyBench: Evaluating LLM legal advice on underspecified user queries
abstract: arXiv:2608.20220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Legal AI systems are increasingly used to answer legal questions, yet existing benchmarks assume queries arrive fully specified. In practice, users omit facts that materially determine the legal outcome. We introduce InsufficiencyBench, the first legal benchmark targeting query-side insufficiency: whether a model recognizes when a query lacks legally material information, identifies what is missing, and refrains from premature conclusions. We formalize a taxonomy of eight canonical missing-element categories across three structural failure modes---switch, gating, and fatal prerequisite--- and construct 202 benchmark items (58 base queries, 144 deficient variants) spanning six legal domains and 24 US jurisdictions and annotated by practising attorneys. Evaluating ten frontier models, we find that no model exceeds F2 = 0.46 on missing-element identification and that the median recall is 0.44. Models either hedge indiscriminately or answer

translated_title: 不足基准：评估大语言模型在信息不完整用户查询中的法律建议
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20220v1 公告类型：新 摘要：法律人工智能系统越来越多地被用于回答法律问题，但现有基准假设查询是完全明确的。在实践中，用户会遗漏对法律结果具有实质影响的事实。我们引入了InsufficiencyBench，这是首个针对查询侧信息不足的法律基准：测试模型是否能识别查询是否缺少法律上实质性的信息，确定缺失的内容，并避免过早得出结论。我们形式化了一个包含八类典型缺失要素的分类体系，涵盖三种结构性失败模式——切换、门控和致命前置条件——并构建了202个基准项目（58个基础查询，144个缺陷变体），覆盖六个法律领域和24个美国司法管辖区，并由执业律师进行注释。评估十个前沿模型后，我们发现没有模型在缺失要素识别上超过F2 = 0.46，中位召回率为0.44。模型要么不加区分地回避，要么直接回答。
tldr: 该论文介绍了首个法律基准InsufficiencyBench，用于评估大语言模型在法律查询信息不完整时的识别、定位和避免过早结论的能力，发现现有前沿模型在此任务上表现不佳。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces InsufficiencyBench, the first legal benchmark evaluating LLMs' ability to recognize, identify, and refrain from premature conclusions when legal queries are information-insufficient, finding that current frontier models perform poorly on this task.
